source_text: A 2023 online survey of 1,135 self-identified foreskin restorers found that 63.46% pursued restoration primarily to address body image deficits and low self-esteem linked to circumcision, with participants describing restoration as a means to restore a sense of wholeness and autonomy over their genitals. [38]
